text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New members were steadily joining the team.
Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower was looking this way,
as if she had something she wanted to say.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm... Rice thought of something this morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I could stop her, Rice Shower fled from the Trainer's room.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, you see, I came up with a team name... Um, "Bloom" means to blossom, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should consider
the team name they suggested!
